name: bananana brain
description: Your own control room for servers, Macs and PCs, reached from anywhere at your-name.bananana.dev without opening ports.
longDescription:
The bananana brain keeps your machines' live readings, alerts, automations, files, terminals and history on your own hardware, not in someone's cloud, and you reach it from anywhere at your-name.bananana.dev and in the bananana.dev apps for iPhone and Android. It connects out through an end-to-end encrypted relay, so it opens no ports and needs no VPN.

First create a free account at bananana.dev/start and copy the setup token it shows (it starts with bst_). Paste it into the installer; it's only used on the first start. Then add your other machines from the brain's Nodes page.

The dashboard is also served on your network at https://<server>:18771 with a self-signed certificate (same sign-in). It only answers on port 18771, so it is published on that port rather than behind a Cosmos route; remote access goes through your-name.bananana.dev.

bananana.dev is free to use under its terms; the app is not open source. Docs: bananana.dev/help/docker, support: bananana.dev/support.
